description: Revoke a delegation by its id (owner revokes access, or a delegate declines their own). The other side is notified. Use list_delegations / list_delegated_to_me to find the id. Requires: token.

delegation_id.description: Required. Delegation id from list_delegations or list_delegated_to_me, integer, e.g. 31.

name: revoke_delegation
title: Revoke a delegation
